metrics.profile_summary: Seasoned marketing leader with 16+ years of experience in brand reinvention and digital transformation across retail, F&B, and e-commerce. Expert in scaling online sales and turning around loss-making businesses into profitable operations.

experience.description: Leads brand reinvention for multi-brand retail/F&B portfolio, achieving 151% sales growth and managing 60+ team members.
Scaled e-commerce sales from 1M to 25M PKR monthly and increased website traffic to 500k users via performance marketing.
Led brand strategy and expanded Tarzz distribution to 500 retail outlets nationwide.
Executed integrated marketing campaigns to drive store traffic and brand visibility.
Managed corporate sales and supported the launch of Apple Authorized Stores in major cities.
Managed account relationships and customer retention initiatives.
Coordinated student engagement, recruitment, and institutional events.

strengths: Proven track record of massive e-commerce scaling
Expertise in GA4 and performance marketing
Strong background in brand turnaround and ROI
weaknesses: Potentially overqualified for a Manager-level role
evaluation.summary: Candidate exceeds all requirements, offering senior-level leadership, deep technical proficiency in GA4/Ads, and a demonstrated ability to drive massive revenue growth for consumer brands in Karachi.
